title: The WiFi Rule
text:
A guest asked for the WiFi password.
I said: "It's on the router."
He said: "I can't find the router."
I said: "Then you've already failed the first test." 📶

title: Gym Membership
text:
I bought a one-year gym membership.
The gym has my money.
I have my excuses.
Honestly, we're both happy. 🏋️

title: Autocorrect's Confidence
text:
Autocorrect has become my most confident friend.
Always wrong.
Never unsure. 📱

title: Monday
text:
Monday is not a day.
It's a personality test
and most of us are failing it weekly. ☕

title: Following a Recipe
text:
Recipe: Add salt to taste.
Me: Adds salt.
Me: Tastes it.
Me: Adds more salt.
Me: Orders food online. 🍳

title: Doctor's Advice
text:
Doctor: You need to avoid stress.
Me: How much will this cost?
Doctor: Quite a lot.
Me: Well, that was a short treatment. 🩺

title: Traffic Logic
text:
Every lane looks faster
until you switch to it.
That's not traffic, that's a personal insult. 🚦

title: Deadlines
text:
I love deadlines.
Especially the sound they make
as they go past. ⏳

title: The Shopping List
text:
I went to buy milk.
I came back with chips, cold drinks, two magazines,
a plant, and a strong feeling
that I forgot something. 🛒

title: Morning Person
text:
I'm not a morning person.
I'm not an evening person either.
I'm a "five more minutes" person,
and it's a full-time role. 😴

title: The Group Project Roles
text:
In every group project there are four roles:
one who works,
one who talks,
one who disappears,
and one who renames the file. 📁

title: Monthly Budget
text:
I made a monthly budget.
It's beautiful.
It's organised.
It has nothing to do with my bank account. 📉

title: Assembly Instructions
text:
The instructions said: "Easy, 10 minutes."
Two hours later I had a shelf,
four extra screws,
and a completely new understanding of myself. 🔩

title: The Weather App
text:
The weather app said 0% chance of rain.
I'm writing this from inside a cloud. 🌧️

title: Battery Anxiety
text:
My phone at 100%: I'll be fine all day.
My phone at 20%: a national emergency.
My phone at 1%: suddenly lasts two hours.
Nobody understands that last one. 🔋

title: Small Talk
text:
"How are you?"
"Good, you?"
"Good."
Two adults completed a full conversation
without exchanging a single piece of information. 🙂
